title: Overlooked and Underutilized: Prototypes are the Missing Piece in Tabular XAI
abstract: arXiv:2611.24831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) is frequently applied to high-stakes tabular data, yet the field relies heavily on feature attribution methods. While these approaches offer technical transparency, evaluating dozens of isolated features demands excessive cognitive effort from non-expert users. In this paper, we argue that prototypes remain overlooked and underutilized, and should be integrated as a complementary, intuitive gateway to auditing complex machine learning models. Although entire exemplars function as an intuitive baseline for prototype-based explanations, we highlight prototypical parts as particularly valuable for tabular data. By grouping related features into bounded subspaces, prototypical parts technically embody human-understandable concepts, replacing isolated features with cohesive semantic units. We support this integration through two primary lenses. Cognitively, these parts align with Rosch's categorization theory and Kahneman

translated_title: 被忽视与未被充分利用：原型是表格数据可解释AI（XAI）中缺失的一环
translated_abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）经常应用于高风险的表格数据，然而该领域严重依赖特征归因方法。虽然这些方法提供了技术上的透明性，但让用户评估数十个孤立的特征需要非专业用户付出过多的认知努力。在本文中，我们认为原型仍然被忽视和未被充分利用，应将其整合为审计复杂机器学习模型的补充性、直观的入口。虽然完整的范例可以作为基于原型的解释的直观基线，但我们强调原型部分对表格数据尤其有价值。通过将相关特征分组到有界的子空间中，原型部分在技术上体现了人类可理解的概念，用连贯的语义单元取代孤立的特征。我们通过两个主要视角支持这一整合。在认知层面，这些部分与Rosch的分类理论和Kahneman（的理论）相符
tldr: 论文提出将原型（尤其是通过将相关特征聚合成有界子空间、体现人类可理解概念的原型部分）作为特征归因方法的直观补充，以降低认知负担的方式帮助用户审计表格数据上的复杂机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that prototypes—especially prototypical parts that group related features into human-understandable bounded subspaces—should complement feature attribution methods as an intuitive, cognitively efficient gateway for auditing machine learning models on tabular data.
